tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bkra shis/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bkra shis/ sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyi bkra shis/ bkra shis gzhan bcas bzhugs so//

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ pañtsa ta thā ga ta maṅga laṃ gā tha/ bod skad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam par snang mdzad ye shes dam pa mtsho chen ldan// zla ba nya 'dra'i sku mnga' srid pa'i mthar phyin pa// dgongs pa mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /mi 'khrugs rgyal po srid dang gti mug rnam sbyong ba// mgon po yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i bkra shis pa// dge mnyam bsam sems ldan pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /sangs rgyas yon tan kun gyi rgyan gyis brgyan mdzad pa// yang dag bden pa'i 'byor pa sbyin mdzad mi bslu ba// rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya'i bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /bsam gtan ting 'dzin dam pa pha rol phyin pa'i gnas// ye shes pad+ma'i steng bzhugs dpag med tshe ldan zhing*/ tshe grangs med par byin gyis brlabs pa'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /sems can don gyi las la thugs ni sbyor mdzad cing*// 'gro ba kun gyi 'ching ba'i bcings las grol mdzad pa// thub mchog don yod grub kyi bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rdzogs so/// / ༈ dam pa tog dkar dga' ldan pho brang dam pa ru// mi pham mgon la rgyal tshab dam par dbang bskur zhing*/ 'dzam gling nyid du glang chen thal dkar ltar gshegs gang*// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer dam pa zas gtsang sras// bud med skyon bral g.yo sgyu spangs pa lha mdzes yum// lhums su zla bcur blo gros ldan pa shākya'i rigs// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog

/lum bi'i tshal ni dben zhing nyams dga' bā la sha'i// yal ga nas bzung bltams gyur tshangs dang brgya byin 'dud// mkha' la gshegs te phyogs bcur pad+ma byung gyur gang*// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /gzhal med khang mdzes drang srong dam pa'i mdun bzhag nas// mtshan ltas shis par brjod de ston pa byung gyur pa// shāka rigs bud med 'khor ldan kun 'dus rgyan btags gang*// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /gzhon nu'i stobs ni sgyu rtsal yig rtsis 'phong las ni// kun las mthar byung lha mi la sogs kun las mchog /shākya'i rigs 'khrungs log rtog sel phyir btsun mo'i 'khor// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /pho brang nas byung rga nad 'chi ba las byung gzigs/ mi rnams dgos mdzad lha yi mdun bdar mkha' la ni// srid gsum dag las brgal phyir mthon mthing dbu skra bregs// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /lha rnams rdzu 'phrul gyis lhags ngur smrig gos rnams phul// ne ra dza na'i chu bor dka' thub ma lus rdzogs// thub pa bsam gtan nas bzhengs bkra shis 'o thug gsol// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /pad+mo las byung khyu mchog byang chub shing drung du// skyil mo krung bcas mi g.yo mchog gis bdud btul nas// tho rangs bdud rtsi mi 'gyur phun tshogs sangs rgyas pa/ bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /wa ra ṇa sir chos kyi 'khor lo mgon pos bskor// kun shes la sogs bden bzhi lnga sde bzang la bstan// lha klu lha min la sogs mi min btud gyur gang*// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /nga rgyal bsnyems pa ldan pa'i ston pa drug brtul zhing*// glang chen rab myos mi bzad lhas byin gyis rbad btul// drang srong mchog la spre'u rgyal cang shes sbrang rtsis mchod/

bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /pad+mo gzhon nu lta bu'i mtshan ldan shākya'i rigs// zas gtsang sras su rgyal rigs 'khor los sgyur rgyal bltams// bltams pa nas bzung sā la'i tshal du ma lus rdzogs// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /byams pa'i stobs kyis 'gro ba ma lus sgrol mdzad cing*/ sems can mtha' yas zhi bde'i lam la rab bkod nas// grong khyer tswa mchog dam par dgongs pa yongs rdzogs gang*// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog// / ༈ bcom ldan rnam par gzigs ni rgyal rigs gzi brjid can// tshe lo brgyad khri'i dus na grong khyer nye ldan du// po ta la'i shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa// deng 'dir bde legs bkra shis phun sum tshogs gyur cig /bde gshegs gtsug tor mnga' ba rgyal rigs rdzu 'phrul can// tsho lo bdun khri'i dus na ka ni'i grong khyer du// shing mchog sin+dhu'i shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa// deng 'dir bde gshegs bkra shis phun sum tshogs gyur cig /rgyal ba thams cad skyob pa rgyal rigs blo gros can// tshe lo drug khri'i dus na grong khyer mnyam med du// shing mchog sā la'i drung du mngon par sangs rgyas pa// deng 'dir bde gshegs bkra shis phun sum tshogs gyur cig /thub pa 'khor ba 'jig ni stobs ldan bram ze'i rigs// tshe lo bzhi khri'i dus na grong khyer mdzes ldan du// shi ri sha yi shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa// deng 'dir bde gshegs bkra shis phun sum tshogs gyur cig /'dren pa gser thub bslab pa mchog ldan bram ze'i rigs// tshe lo sum khri'i dus na grong khyer bde ldan du// u dum bā ra'i shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa// deng 'dir bde gshegs bkra shis phan sum tshogs gyur cig /skyob pa 'od srung rgyal rigs bla med yon tan can// tshe lo nyi khri'i dus na grong khyer bā ra ṇa si ru// n+ya gro dha yi shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa// deng 'dir bde gshegs bkra shis phun sum tshogs gyur cig

/'gro mgon shākya thub pa rgyal rigs brtson 'grus can// tshe lo brgya pa'i dus na ser skya'i grong khyer du// a shwa ta yi shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa// deng 'dir bde gshegs bkra shis phun sum tshogs gyur cig /phun tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa// sangs pad+ma rgyas pa'i 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba// bkra shis des ni skye rgu'i zhi byed dang po'o// de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba// 'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa// chos kyi dam pa skye rgu rnams lazhi byed pa// de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o// dge 'dun dam pa'i chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas// tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gyi gzhi// de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o// che ba'i che mchog ston mchog bla na med// chos rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyis// bdud dang bgegs rigs gnod pa'i dgra zhi ste// rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shis shog /chos nyid bden pa'i chos mchog bla na med// dam chos bdud rtsi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// nyes pa'i skyon bral dge tshogs rnam par 'phel// rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shis shog /dge 'dun rin chen yon tan dpal 'bar ba// rgyal sras phan mdzad bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// nyon mong sdug bsngal gdung ba'i dgra zhi ste// rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shis shog /tshangs dang lha dbang srung ma'i byin rlabs kyis// phan mdzad lha yis bkra shis gnas gyur te// bde legs bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan par shog// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ bkra shis par gyur cig /sangs rgyas gtso la yon tan mchog mnga' zhing*// che dgus mchod cing smon lam sprin tshogs 'dud// go 'phang ston pa'i chos kyi char 'bebs pa/

bkra shis des kyang skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog /skyob pa'i chos la legs pa'i tshogs mnga' zhing*// shin tu phan dang bde dang des gsungs pa// 'khor ba rtag bde mya ngan med thob pa'i// bkra shis des kyang skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog /dge 'dun chos la mthu rtsal rmad mnga' zhing*// bslab gzhi legs bcas brtson pa'i rnal 'byor can// bdag gzhan don chen sgrub pas lam zhugs pa// bkra shis des kyang skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog// /sarba maṅga laṃ/ dge'o// dge'o// dge'o/// /
